title: Maia Solomon
text:
I am a third-year PhD student in Political Science at the University of Houston. My research interests include gender and political representation, judicial politics, and the presidency. More specifically, I am interested in how political and institutional pressures shape presidential nominations to the federal judiciary, particularly through the lens of the glass cliff phenomenon and symbolic representation.
I hold a Master of Science in Homeland Security Studies and a Bachelor of Science in Criminal Justice from Sam Houston State University. In addition to my doctoral studies, I work as an Emergency Management Specialist at the University of Houston, where I support institutional emergency preparedness, planning, and outreach initiatives.

title: Maia Solomon
text:
Working Papers

Gendered Judicial Nominations and the Glass Cliff in the Federal Judiciary — Work in progress. Examines whether political and institutional pressures influence presidential decisions to nominate women to federal courts, with particular attention to state policy environments and presidential partisanship.
